race.comment: SYMBOLISE (8) is building nicely, most recently closing off strongly into a narrow fourth after having some difficulty getting clear in the straight. Splits suggest she will relish the rise in trip, and she gets a key switch in Thompson. Ready. DUAL MASTERY (1) is desperate to break through, with four consecutive placings to open this prep. Couldn't get the job done as a heavy fav last time at Toowoomba but is drawn to advantage and doesn't need to improve much to be right there again. ICY LAD (6) improved sharply on heavy ground at Eagle Farm when sent forward, only to be run down late. Suspect they look to cross from the wide draw and lead again, and with added fitness she could go one better. XAMI (11) closed off soundly into the placings behind Veomas on debut and is sure to have come on from that. Appears she will relish the extra 300m and is one to keep in mind.
